# ScrapeCreators

ScrapeCreators extracts public profiles, posts, videos, comments, ads, and other data from social media and content platforms.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/scrapecreators/.

## Actions

- **Find Creator Social Profiles** (read-only): Discover and verify a creator's linked profiles across supported social platforms from one source handle.
- **Get Credit Balance** (read-only): Return the connected ScrapeCreators account's remaining prepaid credit balance without consuming credits.
- **Get Facebook Ad** (read-only): Return creative, advertiser, platform, delivery, spend, reach, and active-period details for one Meta Ad Library ad.
- **Get Facebook Post** (read-only): Return content, author, media, engagement, and the feedback ID for one public Facebook post or reel.
- **Get Facebook Profile** (read-only): Return public identity, audience, contact, business, and Ad Library metadata for one Facebook profile or Page.
- **Get GitHub Repository** (read-only): Return public metadata, ownership, popularity, language, topics, license, and activity for one GitHub repository.
- **Get GitHub User** (read-only): Return public identity, biography, organization, location, social links, and repository and follower counts for one GitHub user.
- **Get GitHub User Contributions** (read-only): Return a GitHub user's public contribution graph for one year, including the annual total and daily counts and intensity levels.
- **Get Google Ad** (read-only): Return creative variations, advertiser, format, regions, impression estimates, and display dates for one Google Ads Transparency ad.
- **Get Instagram Media Transcript** (read-only): Transcribe speech from an Instagram video or reel under two minutes, returning one transcript per video slide when applicable.
- **Get Instagram Post** (read-only): Return detailed metadata and engagement for one Instagram post or reel.
- **Get Instagram Profile** (read-only): Return public identity, biography, verification, links, and account statistics for one Instagram profile.
- **Get LinkedIn Ad** (read-only): Return advertiser, creative, destination, targeting, impressions, and run dates for one public LinkedIn ad.
- **Get LinkedIn Company** (read-only): Return public company identity, industry, workforce, funding, headquarters, specialties, and website data from LinkedIn.
- **Get LinkedIn Post** (read-only): Return content, author, publication date, engagement, and embedded comments for one public LinkedIn post or article.
- **Get LinkedIn Profile** (read-only): Return public professional identity, experience, education, activity, and audience data for one LinkedIn person profile.
- **Get Reddit Post** (read-only): Return content, author, community, score, flags, media URL, and comment count for one public Reddit post.
- **Get Reddit Subreddit** (read-only): Return public metadata, rules, audience size, and activity statistics for one subreddit.
- **Get Threads Post** (read-only): Return content, author, media, engagement, comments, and related context for one public Threads post.
- **Get Threads Profile** (read-only): Return public identity, biography, links, verification, privacy, and follower data for one Threads profile.
- **Get TikTok Ad** (read-only): Return creative, advertiser, objective, landing-page, performance, audience, and video details for one TikTok ad.
- **Get TikTok Profile** (read-only): Return public identity, bio, verification, and account statistics for one TikTok creator.
- **Get TikTok Video** (read-only): Return metadata, engagement, author, music, and media URLs for one TikTok video.
- **Get TikTok Video Transcript** (read-only): Extract a timestamped WEBVTT transcript from a TikTok video under two minutes.
- **Get Twitter Profile** (read-only): Return public identity, biography, verification, audience, business, and subscription metadata for one X/Twitter account.
- **Get Twitter Tweet** (read-only): Return content, author, media, views, and engagement for one public X/Twitter post.
- **Get Twitter Tweet Transcript** (read-only): Return the available transcript for a video under two minutes attached to one public X/Twitter post.
- **Get YouTube Channel** (read-only): Return public profile, subscriber and view statistics, tags, country, and linked accounts for one YouTube channel.
- **Get YouTube Video** (read-only): Return metadata, engagement, chapters, creator, paid-promotion status, and caption-track availability for one YouTube video or Short.
- **Get YouTube Video Transcript** (read-only): Return timestamped and plain-text public captions for a YouTube video or Short, including long videos when captions exist.
- **List Facebook Company Ads** (read-only): Return one page of Meta Ad Library ads for a company or Page with delivery, status, media, language, date, and sort filters.
- **List Facebook Post Comments** (read-only): Return one page of comments on a Facebook post or reel, accepting its URL or the faster feedback ID.
- **List Facebook Profile Posts** (read-only): Return one page of up to three public posts from a Facebook profile or Page with a cursor for the next page.
- **List GitHub Trending Repositories** (read-only): Return GitHub's current trending repositories filtered by programming language, period, and optional spoken language.
- **List GitHub User Activity** (read-only): Return one month page of a GitHub user's public contribution activity for a selected year.
- **List GitHub User Pull Requests** (read-only): Return one page of a GitHub user's public pull requests, sorted newest first, with optional creation-date filters and a cursor for the…
- **List GitHub User Repositories** (read-only): Return one page of repositories associated with a GitHub user, filtered by ownership and sort order, with a cursor for the next page.
- **List Google Company Ads** (read-only): Return one page of Google Ads Transparency creatives for a company.
- **List Instagram Post Comments** (read-only): Return one page of comments on an Instagram post or reel.
- **List Instagram User Posts** (read-only): Return one page of a public Instagram user's posts, reels, photos, videos, and carousels with a cursor for the next page.
- **List LinkedIn Company Posts** (read-only): Return one numeric page of public posts from a LinkedIn company Page.
- **List Reddit Post Comments** (read-only): Return one page of public comments or replies for a Reddit post.
- **List Reddit Subreddit Posts** (read-only): Return one page of posts from a subreddit with sort and timeframe controls and an opaque cursor for the next page.
- **List Threads User Posts** (read-only): Return the currently public recent posts for one Threads profile in a single response.
- **List TikTok Profile Videos** (read-only): Return one page of a TikTok creator's posted videos, sorted by latest or popularity, with a cursor for the next page.
- **List Twitter User Tweets** (read-only): Return the public tweets currently exposed for one X/Twitter account in a single response.
- **List YouTube Channel Videos** (read-only): Return one page of videos uploaded by a YouTube channel, sorted by latest or popularity, with an opaque cursor for the next page.
- **Search Facebook Ad Library** (read-only): Search Meta's public Ad Library by keyword with country, language, status, media, date, and political-ad filters, returning one page and…
- **Search Google Advertisers** (read-only): Search Google Ads Transparency advertisers by name or keyword in one country.
- **Search LinkedIn Ads** (read-only): Search LinkedIn's public Ad Library by company, company ID, or keyword with country and date filters, returning one page and an opaque…
- **Search LinkedIn Posts** (read-only): Search Google-indexed public LinkedIn posts by keyword and optional recency, returning one page and a bounded continuation cursor.
- **Search Reddit** (read-only): Search Reddit posts or comments by keyword with type, sort, and timeframe filters, returning one page and a continuation cursor.
- **Search Threads Posts** (read-only): Search public Threads posts by keyword and optional inclusive date range, returning the provider's single, non-pageable result set.
- **Search TikTok Ad Library** (read-only): Search TikTok's public ad library by general query or advertiser name, returning one page and an opaque cursor.
- **Search YouTube** (read-only): Search YouTube for videos, Shorts, channels, or playlists with date, popularity, duration, and region filters, returning one page and a…
